item.text: I’ll use `privileges.global.can('view:users', req.uid || 'guests')` to make anonymous access explicitly inherit Guest permissions, while authenticated requests use their UID. The response URLs will be absolute, based on the configured site URL, with `/uid/<uid>` and canonical `/user/<userslug>` profiles.

The route and controller are in place. I spotted a typo in the link relation during the edit; I’m correcting it to a sensible WebFinger profile relation, then I’ll check project lint and the existing test suite as requested.
